- This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) and [CubersLive](https://www.facebook.com/CubersLive)

- CubersLive will be our main broadcast partner in live-streaming our event, as well as hosting our 3x3 finals head-to-head matchups!

- The CubingUSA Western Championship 2023 will be held in Berkeley, California, on June 30 to July 2nd, 2023. Featuring 16 different events, Speedcubers from the CubingUSA-recognized West region of California, Hawaii, and Nevada will be eligibile for the title of Western Champion!

- Tilden and Pauley Ballroom share the same address. Tilden is on the 5th floor and Pauley is on the 2nd floor.

***Our schedule is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***
# Competitors can bring 1 guest for free. There will be a $10 guest/spectator fee for any additional guests that we will accept payment over PayPal pre-competition or at the registration desk.
